data.value: em$ is {game}'s virtual currency that can be used to purchase items in the Store, such as weapons, equipment, clothing and much more.

data.name: Bank.Q2
data.value: How do I buy em$ as a gift to a friend?

data.name: Bank.A2
data.value: In the "Buy em$" tab of this window, check the "Purchase as a gift" check box and then click on the "BUY" button of the currency amount you wish to purchase. You will be taken to a purchase summary on the Steam website. Click on the "Authorize" button. You will be taken to a confirmation page (thank you for your purchase). Click on your em$ balance on the top of the screen (where it says "em$ XXXX") and check your {0}Purchase History{1}. The most recent entry in your Purchase History should read "Purchased as gift. Gift code:", followed by the gift code. Copy the code and send it to the friend you want to give it as a gift. Your friend will then have to redeem the code in order for the em$ gift to be added to their balance.

data.name: Bank.Q3
data.value: How do I redeem a gift code?

data.name: Bank.A3
data.value: Click on the "Redeem a discount code" button on the top-right corner of this window, then paste your gift code there and click on the "OK" button. A confirmation message will appear, click on the "Click here to redeem this gift" button. A message will appear confirming that your gift has been added to your account. Click OK and enjoy your gift!

data.name: Bank.Q4

data.name: Bank.A4
data.value: Once a sale or discount has expired we are unable to offer the discounted price.

data.name: Bank.A5
data.value: As with most digital currencies, we do not offer refunds for purchases of em$. The game is free to download and try out, please verify it does work on your computer and it is what you expect before purchasing em$.

data.name: Bank.A6
data.value: Please note that em$ cannot be sold or transferred, and cannot be exchanged for cash or anything else except for the actual {game} content. em$ are non-refundable. em$ have no monetary value and do not constitute currency or property of any type.

data.name: Help.Support.Intro
data.value: {game} has several official support channels. A lot of information on how to play the game as well as troubleshooting can be found on our community maintained Wiki page. Our official {game} forums are very active and visited daily by many of our players that are happy to help beginners.

data.name: Help.Support.Ticket

data.name: Help.Guides.Text
data.value: {game} has a large community, check out some of these great resources created by our members.

data.name: Help.Tut.Intro
data.value: Learn the basics of how to play {game}. Make sure to go through the {0}playable tutorials{1} as well before going on your first hunt in the Evergreen Hunting Reserve!

data.name: Help.Community.Text
data.value: {game} has a vibrant community and many of our players hang out in local communities with players from their region! Check out these local {game} community fan sites!

data.name: DayHelp.Intro.1
data.value: Daily missions are a brand new addition to {game}'s mission system that can be found in the {0}Missions section{1} in the Launcher or Website.

data.name: DayHelp.Intro.2
data.value: As they are meant to be completed in one day, Daily Missions are supposed to be quite simple and most will not require specific weapons or equipment. Hard Daily Missions may sometimes be an exception to this, but don't be discouraged! You can complete Dailies in Multiplayer if you like.

data.name: DayHelp.How.1
data.value: Each day every player receives a new Daily Mission to complete. Different players will receive different Daily Missions (DM from now on).

data.name: DayHelp.How.2
data.value: Completing a DM increases your DM streak by 1. A {0}streak{1} is defined as a series of completed consecutive DMs.

data.name: DayHelp.How.3
data.value: Skipping or failing to complete a DM will "break your streak" and will bring you back to day one.

data.name: DayHelp.How.4
data.value: If you break your streak, Daily Missions will become inactive until you either Activate them to start a new streak or resume your last streak. A broken streak can be recovered using a {0}Resume Streak{1} service from the Store to continue from your last completed Daily Mission.

data.name: DayHelp.Diff.Intro
data.value: DMs come in three difficulty levels:

data.name: DayHelp.Diff.1
data.value: Each difficulty level is color-coded: an easy DM is represented by a green icon, a medium DM by a blue icon, and a hard DM by a red icon.

data.name: DayHelp.Diff.2
data.value: In addition to colors, each difficulty level has a different number of stars: 1 star for easy, 2 stars for medium, and 3 stars for hard.

data.name: DayHelp.Diff.3
data.value: Each difficulty level comes with different base rewards: {0}100 gm$ for Easy, 500 gm$ for Medium, and 1000 gm$ for Hard{1} respectively.

data.name: DayHelp.Diff.4
data.value: Rewards increase as your DMs streak gets longer, more on this below.

data.name: DayHelp.Prog.1
data.value: Your first DM will always be an easy one. If you complete it, DMs of different difficulty levels will alternate according to a pattern that we call a {0}cycle{1}.

data.name: DayHelp.Prog.3
data.value: As you can see a cycle lasts for 16 days, provided of course that you keep completing the DMs that are assigned to you day after day.

data.name: DayHelp.Prog.4
data.value: Once the first cycle is completed, a new cycle begins with {0}gm$ rewards increased by 10%{1} (Easy = 110 gm$, Medium = 550 gm$, Hard = 1100 gm$).

data.name: DayHelp.Prog.5
data.value: With every subsequent cycle, rewards increase by an extra 10% up to a maximum of double the amount of the base rewards (a 100% increase).

data.name: DayHelp.Prog.6
data.value: So for example, if you manage to complete 10 cycles in a row without breaking your streak you will then receive a x2 reward for each mission, which will continue until you break your streak.

data.name: DayHelp.Reg.1
data.value: Unlike regular missions, for a harvest to be valid in DMs, you will have to kill the animal yourself. Friends can still help you {0}find{1} the required animal in a Multiplayer session though.

data.name: DayHelp.Reg.2
data.value: Unlike regular missions, Daily Missions don't need to be activated. A Daily Mission is always active for the time it lasts (24 hours).

data.name: DayHelp.Ach.1
data.value: You can earn achievements by completing DMs. You can check your DM achievements in the Achievements section of your player's profile:

data.name: DayHelp.Ach.2
data.value: Completing DMs will count towards 3 different types of achievements, one for each difficulty level.

data.name: DayHelp.Ach.3
data.value: Here's a table showing the milestones for each difficulty level:

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.1
data.value: As you progress through your DM streak you will receive special rewards for completing Hard (difficulty) DMs.

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.2
data.value: Special rewards come in the form of:

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.3
data.value: Items and trophies are exclusive rewards that you can win only by completing DMs (i.e. there's no other way to obtain them!). Your rewards will only show at the start of a new game.

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.4
data.value: {0}IMPORTANT:{1} All of the DM's Special Rewards can only be won once! If you break your streak and start a new one, you will still receive gm$ but will need to surpass your previous streak to earn new Special rewards.

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.5
data.value: You will be able to see any special rewards in the Rewards section of your DM:

data.name: DayHelp.Rewards.6
data.value: Here's a handy table showing how this works:

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.1
data.value: As the name suggests, this service allows you to resume a DM's streak. For example, if you have a long streak of completed DMs and then missed or failed a DM, you can use this service to resume your streak and continue from your last completed DM.

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.2
data.value: The good thing is, it doesn't matter how much time has passed since you broke your streak, you will always be able to resume it - even if you broke it, say, a year before.

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.3
data.value: This service can be purchased in advance and activated when needed. There is no limit to how many of these cards you can purchase or own.

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.4
data.value: You can purchase this service directly on the DM page: as soon as you break your streak a button will appear to the left of your "Day 1" DM, prompting you to buy it (or use it, if you already own at least one).

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.5
data.value: Alternatively, you can purchase it from the {0}Store{1}.

data.name: DayHelp.Resume.6
data.value: Once purchased you will be able to use this service directly on the DM page:
